description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called ChapterDrawer, which displays a side navigation panel listing chapters, allowing user interaction to select chapters. It uses Provider for state management and constructs UI components like Drawer, ListTile, Icon, and Text based on the book's chapters and current selection.

classes.name: ChapterDrawer
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a drawer that lists chapters and allows selection.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ChapterDrawer, rendering the list of chapters with selection and navigation logic.
